stemMd: Which statement cannot be true in any permitted order?

options.textMd: Market and Harbour must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Library and Island must occupy consecutive positions, in either order." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Island → Market → Harbour → Library → Park
- Market → Island → Harbour → Library → Park

independentSolve.workingNotes: Blind re-solve in the 5 November 2026 AI audit of this expansion (the review packet held no key, explanation or distractor notes; status "verified_key_agreement"; it checked for competing defensible answers and flagged none): Independently enumerated all 120 permutations of Harbour, Island, Library, Market, Park. Rules Library must occur after Harbour and before Park. Island and Market must occupy consecutive positions, in either order. Harbour must not be in position 1. leave 2 valid orders: Island>Market>Harbour>Library>Park; Market>Island>Harbour>Library>Park. Choice true counts: a=1, b=0, c=1, d=1; impossible requires zero matches.
